title: Reading-H physical-empty bounded test is blocked at the common-owner boundary
question: Can TECT evaluate F_total[G_*]-F_total[E], full Reading-H stationarity and symmetry-projected transverse stability after freezing one common finite-regulator contract and preregistering a physical-empty branch E?
method: Freeze the comparison orientation and enumerate the fifteen mandatory common-owner fields: finite functional, reference, normalization, finite parts, regulator, volume, boundary, limit order, both representations, full tangent, symmetry orbit, projector and error budgets.
Hash-check the latest R-169 v1.4 owner boundary, the R-170 applicability audit, the EXP-000790 same-H contract and the prior R-418 blocker before admitting any numerical lane.
Preregister E as a normalized constrained/no-condensate/empty-preparation slot without identifying it with zero or the P1 zero/disordered reference.
Run primary and non-importing independent input audits, hostile alias/substitution/premature-evaluation mutations, and the Lean implication-only preregistration firewall.
finding: The primary lane passes 27/27 assertions and the independent lane passes 23/23. The hostile lane rejects 7/7 invalid mutations. The integrated verifier passes 39/39 checks and Lean R420 compiles. The latest authorities agree that the Reading-H G_* covariance owner is not a common finite-volume finite-regulator F_total, and no normalized physical-empty E branch or full Reading-H-to-P1 map is admitted. The sign, full Reading-H stationarity and symmetry-projected transverse stability therefore remain BLOCKED_NOT_EVALUATED; no numerical energy or Hessian payload is emitted.
decision_reason: The requested finite test cannot be evaluated honestly until the owner supplies one hash-pinned common parent and instantiates E in that parent. The correct bounded advance is a new preregistration slot plus an executable blocker, not a zero-reference substitution or a fabricated finite-part normalization.

adversarial_review.check: Aliasing E to zero or the P1 zero/disordered reference is rejected without a registered full map.
Combining Reading-H G_* with a P1 or other finite parent is rejected as a cross-owner substitution.
An unspecified finite-part or scalar shift cannot create the missing state-dependent comparison.
Omitting the thermodynamic-then-continuum order rejects the contract before evaluation.
Covariance-owner stationarity is not promoted to full-field stationarity on an absent tangent.
No projected Hessian is formed without a common orbit tangent, projector and error budget.
A blocked input audit is not promoted to a physical vacuum, Yang-Mills result or mass gap.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing preregistration and input-admissibility test only. It proves no sign, stationarity, transverse stability, physical-empty identification, thermodynamic/continuum limit, Yang-Mills result, mass gap, C6, Sector-A or Pre-A closure.
decision_scope: Same-owner finite contract and E preregistration; no numerical evaluation and no tier change.
next_action: Require an owner-approved hash-pinned common finite-regulator parent, instantiate E with a normalized state/configuration, boundary preparation and local no-condensate criterion, map G_* and E into that parent, and freeze the full tangent, symmetry projector, finite parts and error budgets before rerunning the three tests.
no_overclaim: This is a reproducible blocker at the current owner boundary, not a universal nonexistence theorem. It does not identify E with zero or a physical vacuum and does not provide a Yang-Mills or mass-gap conclusion.
